Q: What is your salary expectation?
A: My expected salary is aligned with the role market range and I am open to discussion.
Q: Why do you want to work here?
A: I want to work here because the team solves practical problems with clear ownership.
Q: How do you handle feedback?
A: I treat feedback as data, ask clarifying questions, and apply it to the next iteration.
Q: Tell me about a conflict with a teammate.
A: I addressed the conflict directly with the teammate, focused on the shared goal, and agreed on next steps.
Q: What is your greatest weakness?
A: I sometimes over-document decisions; I am learning to balance thoroughness with speed.
Q: Where do you see yourself in five years?
A: In five years I want to own a critical system and mentor newer engineers.
